title: MFA enrollment loop after password reset
symptoms: After a successful password reset, the user is repeatedly redirected to register MFA even though a valid method is already present.
root_cause: A stale enrollment-state cookie conflicts with the server-side MFA registration record.
workaround: Revoke active sessions, clear the identity-portal cookies, wait two minutes, and start a new private browser session. Do not delete a valid MFA method.
permanent_fix: Planned identity-portal release 2025.4 invalidates stale enrollment cookies after password reset.

title: New group membership delayed on SaaS applications
symptoms: Active Directory membership is correct but the target SaaS application does not show the entitlement for up to forty minutes.
root_cause: The SaaS connector processes group deltas on a thirty-minute schedule and can miss the first cycle during queue pressure.
workaround: Verify effective directory membership, trigger one approved connector synchronization, then refresh the user's application session.
permanent_fix: Connector 4.9 introduces event-driven group delta processing.

title: Managed software installation remains pending
symptoms: An approved package remains in Pending state although the device is online and compliant.
root_cause: A corrupted local package-manifest cache prevents assignment evaluation.
workaround: Run the approved endpoint-agent cache repair action, initiate policy sync, and retry the existing assignment. Do not manually install an untracked package.
permanent_fix: Endpoint agent 7.2.1 automatically repairs an invalid package manifest.

title: Deployment dashboard reports stale pre-change health
symptoms: The production deployment dashboard shows healthy metrics from the previous release instead of the active deployment window.
root_cause: The dashboard cache key omits the immutable release identifier.
workaround: Use the direct monitoring dashboard linked from the approved change record and verify its release identifier before making a proceed or rollback decision.
permanent_fix: Release dashboard 3.12 adds the release identifier to all health-cache keys.

title: Jira Cloud REST requests return 401 with valid browser access
symptoms: The user can open Jira in a browser, but GET /rest/api/3/myself returns HTTP 401 from a script.
root_cause: The script uses an account password, an API token issued for another Atlassian account, or an email alias that does not match the token owner.
workaround: Create a replacement Atlassian API token while signed in to the intended account, authenticate with the exact account email, and retest /rest/api/3/myself.
permanent_fix: For distributed applications, replace user API tokens with an approved OAuth 2.0 integration.
